title: Decoration & Wallcoverings
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Substrate prepared (filled, sanded, clean, dry) before the first coat?
Colour per the finishes schedule; no runs, misses, roller marks or grinning under raking light?
Wallcoverings set out plumb, pattern matched, seams tight with no bubbles?
Clean lines at junctions, and the area protected?
Ask the fitter: What finish level are you working to, and when do shadow gaps get painted? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Mist coat applied to new plaster before finish coats?
Woodwork filled, sanded and finished with no brush marks?
Wallcovering batch numbers consistent within each room?

notOk.t: Shadow gaps not clean, straight and fully painted
Grinning filler, rough corners and trims
Poor cut-in lines to ceilings, skirting and frames
Masking tape, paint or residue left on floors, frames, tiles
Plaster-in fittings painted over so they can't be removed
